# The meta

The reference playbook's default engine, at the weights it was calibrated at: rate 1, synergy 0.1 and counter 0.05, scaled by a meta of 1. The solver tests that run the engine pin their sixes and scores under these, so tuning the live playbook's meta.md moves none of them.
